features: Multiple benefit items with individual configuration
Manual or dynamic data source options per item
shortDescription: The Benefits Box Studio block presents shop advantages in a compact, scannable format. Merchants can add multiple benefit items, each configurable with manual content or dynamic data from backend systems. Typical uses include highlighting free shipping thresholds, return policies, secure payment options, or customer service availability. The block works well on product pages to reinforce purchase confidence or on landing pages to communicate brand value.
